name: SDN Host File Node
description: Capability node wrapping the host filesystem hostcall group (filesystem.readFile / filesystem.writeFile). Method "read_file": input "request" JSON {"path":"..."} -> output "content" raw file bytes verbatim. Method "write_file": input "content" raw bytes plus "request" JSON {"path":"..."} -> output "result" JSON {"ok":true,"bytesWritten":N,"path":"..."}. HOST SUPPORT (verified 2026-07): the SDK NodeHost serves filesystem.* against a sandboxed root; the SDK BrowserHost serves filesystem.* only when constructed with a filesystem adapter (OPFS or in-memory) — absent adapter, calls fail closed. The Go server host (sdn-server modulert) has NO filesystem capability handler today (internal/modulert/caps has no filesystem.go), so server-side invokes fail with operation-not-supported until a filesystem cap handler lands. This gap is documented, not worked around.

externalInterfaces.description: Host sandboxed filesystem hostcalls. Cross-host today: SDK NodeHost (built-in sandbox root) and SDK BrowserHost (requires a configured filesystem adapter). Go server host: not yet implemented.

acceptedTypeSets.description: UTF-8 JSON bytes (aligned-binary wire format): {"path":"<host-sandbox-relative path>"}.
Raw file bytes (aligned-binary wire format), passed through verbatim from the filesystem.readFile hostcall binary segment.

methods.description: Reads a file through filesystem.readFile and emits the bytes verbatim. BATCHING: every input port here is single-stream BY CONTRACT and that is now ENFORCED IN CODE, not merely declared. maxStreams/maxBatch/drainPolicy are purely DECLARATIVE in the compiled flow runtime - space_data_module_runtime_begin_node_invocation pops the node whole queue port-blind up to the drain budget (64) - so a node that read ordinal 0 of a port and returned used to destroy every other frame it was handed there, with nothing re-delivering them and nothing logging the loss (live P1 cellular-multiprovider-returns-only-first-provider). A surplus is now refused with error code "batched-input-frames", naming the port and the count. See graph task modules-guest-nodes-drop-batched-frames.

acceptedTypeSets.description: Raw bytes to write (aligned-binary wire format); forwarded verbatim as the hostcall binary segment.
UTF-8 JSON bytes (aligned-binary wire format): {"path":"<host-sandbox-relative path>"}.
UTF-8 JSON bytes (aligned-binary wire format): {"ok":true,"bytesWritten":<content byte count>,"path":"<host-resolved path when reported, else the requested path>"}.
